headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 11, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Jalen Beeks of the Texas Rangers, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to low back spasms. Other notable injuries include Oneil Cruz of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Sebastián Rivero of the Los Angeles Angels, Jack Kochanowicz of the Los Angeles Angels, Kyle Isbel of the Kansas City Royals, Matt Brash of the Seattle Mariners, Tyler Gilbert of the Chicago White Sox, and Ronald Acuña Jr. of the Atlanta Braves.

The Detroit Tigers have acquired Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers in a trade. Other notable trades include the Pittsburgh Pirates trading Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners for cash, the Tampa Bay Rays trading Raynel Delgado to the Houston Astros for cash, the Arizona Diamondbacks trading Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash, and the Texas Rangers trading Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Angel Martínez led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Giants Walk-Off in Thrilling 11-10 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants edged out the Washington Nationals 11-10 in a back-and-forth contest. Matt Chapman led the Giants' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres took down the Cincinnati Reds 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Fernando Tatis Jr. led the Padres' offense with a pair of hits, including a home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rangers Place Jalen Beeks on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers left-handed pitcher Jalen Beeks has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to low back spasms, effective retroactive to June 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Waguespack Joins Tigers**
top_news.summary: Jacob Waguespack has been traded to the Detroit Tigers. The Milwaukee Brewers dealt the right-handed pitcher to the Tigers in a trade.
